note:
1805 -> 1785, all twenty in addons/web/static/src.

WHERE THIS GATE'S WEB DEBT ACTUALLY IS: of the 1738 errors tsc reports under
addons/web, only 36 are in static/src. The other 1702 are in static/tests. The
production code is very nearly type-clean and the test tree is not, which is the
opposite of what a single 1738 suggests, and it is why this change is 20 rather
than a few hundred.

  addons/web/static/src     36 -> 16
  addons/web/static/tests 1702 -> 1702

  res_user_group_ids_field.js  12 -> 5   `import { Record } from "@web/model/record"`
      shadows TS's own Record<K,V>, so every `{Record<string, any>}` in the file's
      JSDoc read as "the Record component, which is not generic". Spelled
      Object<string, any>, which is what those parameters are. The five that
      remain are real mismatches the twelve had been masking -- with the type no
      longer broken, TS now checks the bodies.
  clickbot.js                   4 -> 0   the two rpcBus handlers destructured
      `{ detail }` off an Event, which does not have one. They read it through a
      CustomEvent<RpcEventDetail> cast, which is what rpc.js's own listeners do.
  ui.js                         3 -> 0   collectTabable declared its root as
      `HTMLElement | DocumentFragment`, and a union of two overload sets is not
      callable, so querySelector/querySelectorAll on it were errors. It is a
      ParentNode; that is the interface it uses.
  datetime_field.js             6 -> 3   dateTimeField and dateRangeField reached
      for dateField.listViewWidth() and called it, on a property the registry
      declares as a number, an array OR a function. The width rules are now two
      plain functions the three entries share. The FieldsRegistryItemShape
      declaration was also missing `options`, which column_width_hook -- the only
      caller -- has always passed.

No file gains an error: the finding set was diffed file by file against the
baseline run.

Measured with the CI command, `npx tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit`, on a
clean worktree at 8b8a26297b0, which reads 1805 -- the floor it replaces still
reproduces.
